name: Gods Eyes
overview: Scripture reveals that the eyes of the LORD are continually attentive to His creation, watching over the land and the ways of mankind from beginning to end (Deuteronomy 11:12; Job 34:21). God’s watchful gaze is not distant but deeply personal, as He protects His people as the 'apple of the eye' and guides them with His counsel (Psalms 17:8; 32:8). His eyes are especially upon those who fear Him and place their hope in His mercy, listening attentively to their cries and caring for the righteous (Psalms 33:18; 34:15). This divine vigilance emphasizes God’s intimate involvement and faithful care for His people.
